text:
anita: nightly eval flagged a big regression on the legal_qa promptset after yesterday's PTQ rollout.

anita: metrics: answer_f1 0.78 -> 0.53, hallucination_rate 2% -> 16%, exact_match 0.61 -> 0.42. failing mostly on entity-supported Qs.

michael: ugh. which build did we push?

anita: redwood-lite-13b-int4-packedkvv2 (build id: rl13b-int4-pkv2-20260318). deployed to hostpool-prod-3 around 02:10 UTC.

sara: i ran a quick diff of token-level logits for a few failure cases. packedkv v2 changes the KV packing layout and the runtime kernel altered the indexing math. looks like special-token calibrations shifted for long-prefix contexts.

josh: we also changed PTQ scale-clip logic in the calibration stage for that release (to reduce outlier sensitivity). combination with packedkvv2 ordering could produce scale misalignment for some token ids.

deploy-bot: Deployment rl13b-int4-pkv2-20260318 -> hostpool-prod-3 completed (at 2026-03-18T02:12:07Z). Canary traffic: 100% (rolled).

anita: ok immediate action: rollback to rl13b-int4-stable-20260310 on hostpool-prod-3. enable canary at 1% for packedkvv2 once fix is landed.

michael: backing rollback now.

deploy-bot: Rollback in progress -> rl13b-int4-stable-20260310 applied to hostpool-prod-3 (at 2026-03-18T02:25:44Z).

sara: for root cause repro i made a tiny harness: compare logits for a seed of 500 legal_qa prompts across builds. added a quick diff script: 

```bash
# run from eng-ml/eval/harness
./run_eval.sh --model rl13b-int4-stable-20260310 --prompts legal_qa_seed500.json --out out.stable.json
./run_eval.sh --model rl13b-int4-pkv2-20260318 --prompts legal_qa_seed500.json --out out.pkv2.json
python3 compare_logits.py out.stable.json out.pkv2.json --report-topk 5 --threshold 1e-2
```

sara: initial diffs show systematic negative shift on logits for tokens in the 200-350 id range (these map to legal-entity tokens in our vocab).

josh: that's consistent with a PTQ scale table row being applied to wrong KV columns due to packing reorder. i'll open a PR to guard the packing indices and add unit tests.

anita: can we add gating to nightly evals so a hallucination_rate bump > 5% for any promptset blocks rollout? need it asap.

michael: adding gating rule to the deployment pipeline: if eval.hallucination_rate(promptset) - baseline > 0.05 -> fail gates and auto-deploy rollback. i'll add a dashboard alert too.

sara: also propose a quick synthetic unit: for each special token idx we run a tiny calibration check after quant tables are computed: ensure per-token scale delta between stable and new < 10%. if not, fail build.

josh: agreed. i'll implement per-token calibration diff and a fallback that forces fp16 for KV rows flagged as outliers.

anita: timeline: rollback done. josh PR to land packedkv idx safeguards today, sara to land harness + unit tests by EOD, michael to add gating + alert and re-run nightly evals. re-run canary to 1% once fixed.

michael: noted. i'll kick off a focused nightly immediate run for legal_qa after tests land.

sara: logging steps in GH issue #INF-2337 with repro and attach sample logits.

anita: thanks everyone. file follow-ups in the issue and ping here when canary is green. :thumbsup:

josh: will also add a small benchmark in the CI matrix to catch regressions for long-prefix entity prompts.

deploy-bot: Canary traffic for rl13b-int4-stable-20260310 now at 100% on hostpool-prod-3 (at 2026-03-18T02:32:12Z).

anita: closing thread when CI + nightlies pass.
